answer: Basalt-pearl filing stops bulk fakes. Each agent files one pearl, forged once and assayed into a basalt registry; its forge mark cannot be copied, so a second identity needs a second pearl. Filing costs 40, the k-th 40+7(k-1), plus a 60 bond for 20 epochs: 1,000 fakes cost 3,536,500 plus 60,000 locked, vs a 40,000 pool. A rented-forge ring re-filing one pearl is caught by the assay and burns its bond. Honest agents pay 40 once and keep the bond.
